definitions.rationale: This nullary equation defines triangleProgram as the exact MPY Module syntax tree quoted from solution.mpy; it names program data and does not add an execution rule or mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule triangleProgram() =>
    Module(
      Import("math")
      FuncDef("triangle_area", Params("a", "b", "c"),
        If(BoolOp(
          "or",
          Compare(BinOp("+", Name("a"), Name("b")), CmpOp("<=", Name("c"))),
          Compare(BinOp("+", Name("a"), Name("c")), CmpOp("<=", Name("b"))),
          Compare(BinOp("+", Name("b"), Name("c")), CmpOp("<=", Name("a")))),
          Return(UnaryOp("-", Int(1))),
          .Stmts)
        Assign(
          Name("semi_perimeter"),
          BinOp(
            "/",
            BinOp("+", BinOp("+", Name("a"), Name("b")), Name("c")),
            Int(2)))
        Assign(
          Name("area"),
          Call(
            Attribute(Name("math"), "sqrt"),
            BinOp(
              "*",
              BinOp(
                "*",
                BinOp(
                  "*",
                  Name("semi_perimeter"),
                  BinOp("-", Name("semi_perimeter"), Name("a"))),
                BinOp("-", Name("semi_perimeter"), Name("b"))),
              BinOp("-", Name("semi_perimeter"), Name("c")))))
        Return(Call(Name("round"), Name("area"), Int(2)))))

definitions.rationale: This equation defines invalidTriangle by expanding it to the three side-sum comparisons joined by Boolean disjunction.
definitions.text:
rule invalidTriangle(A, B, C) =>
       applyCmp("<=", applyBin("+", A, B), C)
    orBool applyCmp("<=", applyBin("+", A, C), B)
    orBool applyCmp("<=", applyBin("+", B, C), A)

definitions.rationale: This equation defines the semiPerimeter summary as the left-associated sum of the three inputs divided by two.
definitions.text:
rule semiPerimeter(A, B, C) =>
    applyBin("/", applyBin("+", applyBin("+", A, B), C), 2)

definitions.rationale: This equation defines heronProduct structurally from semiPerimeter and the four factors in Heron's product.
definitions.text:
rule heronProduct(A, B, C) =>
    applyBin(
      "*",
      applyBin(
        "*",
        applyBin(
          "*",
          semiPerimeter(A, B, C),
          applyBin("-", semiPerimeter(A, B, C), A)),
        applyBin("-", semiPerimeter(A, B, C), B)),
      applyBin("-", semiPerimeter(A, B, C), C))

definitions.rationale: This equation defines triangleAreaSpec as the contract summary: minus one for an invalid triangle and otherwise the rounded square root of heronProduct.
definitions.text:
rule triangleAreaSpec(A, B, C) =>
    #if invalidTriangle(A, B, C)
    #then -1
    #else applyBuiltin(
            "round",
            sqrtF({heronProduct(A, B, C)}:>Float),
            (2, .Vals))
    #fi
